page.description: How docstube turns writer claims into anchored, checked, unchecked, or contradicted documentation states.
page.title: How verification works

findings.message: The built-in verifier behavior section is presented as operationally authoritative even though all of its detailed behavior claims are unchecked.
findings.rationale: The page brief asks to explain what each built-in verifier checks, but the section lists claims c63-c74 for those checks and the ledger marks every one as `unchecked (no-checker-available)`. That makes unchecked behavior claims carry the core substance of the section.

findings.message: The sentence 'After a page is accepted, the kernel owns the durable record' is an unmarked architectural assertion.
findings.rationale: The sentence asserts a checkable system behavior about what component owns the durable record after acceptance, but it is outside any Claim marker and is not the linter-detected span listed for the page.
